title: BFM Speed Recording with Back-Focal-Plane Interferometry
author: Teuta Pilizota
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bch2it8e
materials: Grow cells to the desired OD

steps.title: Truncate flagellar filaments
steps.instruction: Pass the bacterial suspension through two 26‑gauge syringes connected by a plastic tube (shearing device) 30–80 times to shorten flagella.

steps.title: Coat tunnel‑slide surface
steps.instruction: Flush 0.1 % poly‑L‑lysine (PLL) through the tunnel‑slide or flow‑cell for 10–20 s, then wash out with ~20 × the channel volume of experimental medium.

steps.title: Wash cells into medium
steps.instruction: Centrifuge cells in microcentrifuge tubes at 8000 g for 2 min, discard supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in 1 mL experimental medium; repeat this wash three times and finally resuspend cells to the desired concentration.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 8000 g for 2 min in microcentrifuge tubes.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL experimental medium.
Adjust final cell concentration as needed.

steps.title: Load cells and attach
steps.instruction: Introduce the sheared, washed cells into the flow‑cell/tunnel‑slide, incubate for 10 min to allow attachment, then flush excess cells out with experimental medium.

steps.title: Add polystyrene beads
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 µm diameter polystyrene beads (Polysciences, Inc., USA) suspended in experimental medium to the flow‑cell/tunnel‑slide, incubate for 10 min, and wash away non‑attached beads.

substeps.instruction: Wash out unattached beads with experimental medium.

steps.title: Place potential spinner
steps.instruction: Position the potential spinner at the focus of the 855 nm continuous‑wave infrared laser (Blue Sky Research, 855 nm).

steps.title: Locate trajectory and record
steps.instruction: Adjust the view to obtain a clear circular trajectory, then record rotation speed using a Position Sensitive Detector (New Focus PSD Model 2931) at 10 kHz sampling with a 2.5 kHz anti‑aliasing filter.

substeps.instruction: Find optimal position for a circular trajectory.
